associations.title: Qualifier invulnérabilité et catégories de dégâts bloquées
associations.finding: Kayle Intervention authored input/text identifies an invulnerability example. Current targeted-cast dispatch rejects unsupported champion spells. Damage admission calls protected(),but that function handles fountains/structure dependencies,not a general champion invulnerability policy.
associations.remaining: Identify the actual invulnerability state and all damage-category gates,original side-effect/order policy and ability/item producers. Structure protection is not evidence of champion invulnerability.

associations.title: Qualifier inciblabilité et projectiles déjà lancés
associations.finding: Fizz Jump authoring/text is identified. Current ground-cast dispatch rejects unsupported spells; basic flight checks target existence/health and tracks position after launch. Those gates do not qualify an untargetable state or its projectile policy.
associations.remaining: Identify untargetability state,acquisition,already-launched missiles,ground/AoE damage and all original exceptions;do not treat missing/dead/hidden as untargetable.

anchors.needle: return Err("champion ground spell not implemented".into());

associations.title: Qualifier immunité aux contrôles et effets secondaires conservés
associations.finding: Olaf Ragnarok authoring/text is identified. Current cast dispatch has no qualified Olaf implementation; stun admission refuses Boss/structures as unsupported local targets. Neither refusal establishes native CC immunity or preservation of secondary effects.
associations.remaining: Identify immunity flags and per-control admission/secondary effects,cleanse-vs-immunity ordering,duration and all original producers;retain support refusals separately.

associations.title: Qualifier boucliers antisorts et ordre de consommation
associations.finding: Sivir E authoring/text identifies a spell-shield example. Current generic Shield absorbs damage after mitigation and orders by expiry;its structure carries amount/tag/deadline,not a qualified hostile-spell consumption event. Sivir cast remains behind the unsupported-spell boundary.
associations.remaining: Identify spell-shield trigger/consumption order,non-damaging spells,multi-hit/secondary effects,recasts and original exemptions. General damage absorption must not count as spell-shield implementation.

associations.title: Qualifier purification et contrôles non dissipables
associations.finding: Garen Q has an actual accepted-cast path clearing timed slows. Exhaust non-slow debuffs and pillar area reapplication are separate. SummonerBoost authoring/text is present,but current summoner enum/dispatch supports Barrier,Heal,Exhaust,Ignite,Smite only;this does not implement Cleanse or QSS.
associations.remaining: Qualify every dispellable/non-dispellable state,cleanse vs suppression/airborne,area reapplication and immunity window;implement/identify Cleanse and item consumers with original rules.

associations.title: Nettoyer les contrôles à la mort selon leurs règles de persistance
associations.finding: Lethal champion damage clears local Effects,shields,slows,stuns,orders and windup,then schedules baseline death time. Stun/slow update also removes dead entries. This is concrete broad cleanup,not qualified per-effect persistence.
associations.remaining: Qualify death-persistent passives/buffs,deferred projectiles,owner-bound entities,revival and all original cleanup ordering;native DeathTimes authoring validates timer inputs only.

associations.title: Nettoyer les états après résurrection et transformation
associations.finding: advance_respawns resets local effect/order/control state for normal timed fountain respawn and clears specific owner effects. Zilean revival and Elise transformation authoring exist as native examples,but their special gameplay paths are not supplied by this baseline respawn consumer.
associations.remaining: Qualify special revival/transform state transfer,form identity,resources,protected windows and persistent effects. Normal respawn cleanup and native description hooks do not prove these mechanisms complete.

associations.title: Conserver ou expirer correctement les états pendant une déconnexion
associations.finding: Two live code paths differ: legacy peer silence>30s removes the actor;resumable Registry emits Detached and Host removes route/clock delivery while retaining Simulation player. Resume rebinds the same player with a new context;Retired/owner drain uses remove_player. Simulation control deadlines continue on ticks while unpaused;silence timeout uses host elapsed time.
associations.remaining: Qualify every control/deferred effect during offline retention,death,owner drain,reconnect and pause;verify real transport behavior and original server policy. Legacy removal must not be generalized to resumable sessions.

invulnerable/Description.text: Shields Kayle or an ally for a short time, causing them to be immune to damage.

invulnerable/DynamicTooltip.text: <titleLeft>Intervention (@Level@)</titleLeft><titleRight>[@Hotkey@]</titleRight><subtitleLeft>No Cost</subtitleLeft><subtitleRight>@Cooldown@ sec Cooldown</subtitleRight><mainText>Bathes Kayle's target in a holy light, rendering them immune to all damage for @Effect1Amount@ seconds.</mainText>

untargetable/Description.text: Fizz hops into the air, landing gracefully upon his spear and becoming untargetable. From this position, Fizz can either slam the ground or choose to jump again before smashing back down.

untargetable/DynamicTooltip.text:
Playful / Trickster (@Level@)[@Hotkey@]@Cost@ Mana@Cooldown@ sec CooldownFizz hops toward your cursor onto his spear, becoming untargetable, and then slams the ground dealing @Effect1Amount@ (+@CharAbilityPower@) magic damage to nearby enemies and slowing them by @Effect2Amount@% for 2 seconds.

Reactivating this ability while Fizz is on top of his spear causes Fizz to jump again towards your cursor and deal @Effect1Amount@ (+@CharAbilityPower@) magic damage in a smaller area to enemies nearby, instead of slamming the ground.

CC_immunity/Description.text: Olaf temporarily becomes immune to disables.

CC_immunity/DynamicTooltip.text:
Ragnarok (@Level@)[@Hotkey@]No Cost@Cooldown@ sec CooldownPassive: Olaf gains @Effect1Amount@ Armor and @Effect1Amount@ Magic Resist.

Active: Olaf removes all disables from himself and becomes immune to them for the next @Effect2Amount@ seconds. During this time, Olaf loses the passive portion of Ragnarok and gains @Effect3Amount@ Attack Damage.

spell_shield/Description.text: Creates a magical barrier that blocks a single enemy ability cast on Sivir. She receives Mana back if a spell is blocked.

spell_shield/DynamicTooltip.text:
Spell Shield (@Level@)[@Hotkey@]No Cost@Cooldown@ sec CooldownSivir creates a magical barrier for @Effect1Amount@ seconds that blocks the next incoming enemy ability.

If an ability is blocked by the shield, Sivir regains @Effect2Amount@ Mana.

slow_cleanse/Description.text: Garen gains a burst of Movement Speed, breaking free of all slows affecting him and his next attack strikes a vital area of his foe, dealing bonus damage and silencing them.

slow_cleanse/DynamicTooltip.text:
Decisive Strike (@Level@)[@Hotkey@]No Cost@Cooldown@ sec CooldownGaren breaks free from all slows affecting him and gains @Effect2Amount@% Movement Speed for @Effect5Amount@ seconds.

His next basic attack within @Effect6Amount@ seconds deals @Effect1Amount@ (+@CharTotalPhysical@) physical damage and silences his target for @Effect3Amount@ seconds.

revival/Description.text: Zilean places a protective time rune on an allied champion, teleporting the champion back in time if they take lethal damage.

revival/DynamicTooltip.text: <titleLeft>Chronoshift (@Level@)</titleLeft><titleRight>[@Hotkey@]</titleRight><subtitleLeft>@Cost@ Mana</subtitleLeft><subtitleRight>@Cooldown@ sec Cooldown</subtitleRight><mainText>Zilean marks himself or an allied champion with a protective time rune for @Effect2Amount@ seconds. If the target would take lethal damage, they are instead transported back in time, regaining @Effect1Amount@ <font color='#99FF99'>(+@CharAbilityPower@)</font> Health.</mainText>

transformation/Description.text: Transforms into a menacing spider with new abilities. While in Spider Form, Elise deals bonus Magic Damage on attack and has increased Movement Speed.

transformation/DynamicTooltip.text:
Spider Form (@Level@)[@Hotkey@]No Cost@Cooldown@ sec CooldownElise transforms into a menacing spider, granting access to arachnid abilities.

Spider Form: Elise deals @Effect1Amount@ (+@CharAbilityPower@) bonus Magic Damage per attack and gains @Effect3Amount@ Movement Speed.

Spiderlings: Spiderlings deal @Effect1Amount@ (+@CharAbilityPower2@) damage and take @Effect4Amount@% reduced damage from multi-target abilities. Max @Effect5Amount@ Spiderlings.

cleanse/Description.text: Removes all disables and summoner spell debuffs affecting your champion and lowers the duration of incoming disables by 65% for 3 seconds.

cleanse/DynamicTooltip.text: <titleLeft>Cleanse</titleLeft><titleRight>[@Hotkey@]</titleRight><subtitleLeft>No Cost</subtitleLeft><subtitleRight>@f2@ second Cooldown</subtitleRight><mainText>Removes all disables and summoner spell debuffs affecting your champion and reduces the duration of disables by 65% for the next @f1@ seconds.</mainText>
